arte.universo: Saint Petersburg, Russia, in the 1860s and 1870s: a 19th-century chemistry professor's study and laboratory lit by oil lamps and candles, wooden desks covered with handwritten paper cards, shelves of glass flasks and bottles with powders and liquids of different colors, snow outside tall windows, brass scales and old instruments. No portraits and no recognizable real people: the scientist is never shown, only his objects.

escena.accion: At night in a 19th-century study, the Pasita stands in front of a huge chart pinned to the wall made of many small paper rectangles in rows, with a few EMPTY spaces that glow softly in lime green
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, seen from behind, small school backpack, looking up at the chart
escena.objeto: The big wall chart of small paper cards in a grid with three glowing empty gaps (cards are blank or illegible)
escena.foreground: The edge of a wooden desk with an oil lamp and scattered blank cards, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita in front of the chart
escena.background: Dark wood-panelled study, tall window with falling snow
escena.iluminacion: Warm oil-lamp light, cold blue moonlight from the window, soft lime glow from the gaps
escena.composicion: Medium-wide shot from behind; the upper 42% is the dark wall and ceiling above the chart

escena.accion: The Pasita stands overwhelmed among crowded shelves of a 19th-century laboratory full of glass bottles and flasks with substances of many colors, in total disorder
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, three-quarter view, hands on her head, overwhelmed
escena.objeto: Dozens of glass bottles and flasks with powders, crystals and liquids of different colors, unlabeled, on chaotic shelves
escena.foreground: A few bottles very close to the camera, slightly blurred, a brass scale
escena.iluminacion: A single warm lamp, colored reflections in the glass
escena.composicion: Wide shot; the upper 42% dark shadowed shelves and ceiling

escena.accion: On a big wooden desk lit by a candle, the Pasita arranges many small handwritten paper cards in rows, like a game of solitaire
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-right, leaning over the desk, placing one card, focused
escena.objeto: Many small paper cards laid out in neat rows on the desk (handwriting illegible)
escena.foreground: A candle, an ink pot and a quill, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita and the rows of cards
escena.iluminacion: Warm candlelight from one side, deep shadows
escena.composicion: Medium shot from slightly above; the upper 42% dark background

escena.accion: Close view of the grid of cards on the desk with clear empty gaps between them; the Pasita points at one empty gap with determination
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, pointing with one finger at the empty space
escena.objeto: The grid of paper cards with three clearly visible empty spaces, one glowing faintly lime green
escena.midground: The Pasita's hand pointing at the gap
escena.iluminacion: Candlelight, a faint lime glow from the gap

cuerpo: Como lo predijo. Y **se derrite en la mano**.

escena.accion: In a dim 1870s laboratory, the Pasita holds a small piece of silvery metal in her open palm and it is melting into a shiny liquid drop
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, middle-lower part, close, amazed wide eyes looking at her own palm
escena.objeto: A small silvery metal piece melting into a mirror-like liquid drop in her palm
escena.foreground: Glass tubes and a flask, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita and the melting metal
escena.iluminacion: Soft lamp light with bright silver reflections on the metal
escena.composicion: Medium close-up; the upper 42% dark laboratory background

escena.accion: In a modern school classroom at night, the Pasita looks up at a giant colorful periodic table poster that fills the wall, all its squares complete
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, seen from behind, backpack on, small in front of the big poster
escena.objeto: A giant periodic-table-shaped grid of colored squares on the wall, with no letters or numbers
escena.foreground: School desks and chairs, slightly blurred
escena.background: The big poster, a dark window
escena.iluminacion: Cold moonlight and a warm desk lamp; the poster softly lit
escena.composicion: Wide shot; the upper 42% dark wall and ceiling above the poster

post:
En 1869 se conocían 63 elementos y nadie sabía cómo ordenarlos. 🧪

Dmitri Mendeléyev los escribió en cartas, los acomodó como un solitario… y dejó huecos para elementos que nadie había visto. Predijo cómo serían. En 1875 apareció el galio, justo como lo dijo (y se derrite en la mano).

Así nació la tabla periódica que hoy tiene 118 elementos. ¿Qué elemento usas todos los días sin saberlo? 👇

#tablaperiodica #quimica #ciencia #prepa #secundaria #pasasmx
